latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Text to Brainrot Video.

- Instantly generate 1080p "brainrot style" videos from your text prompts using cloud GPUs.
- No manual editing or export settings needed—just type your idea and download a ready-to-share MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic account setup: get started with a free token for quick access (100 credits, 7 days).
- Supports uploading text files and customizing videos with options for aspect ratio, overlays, and audio.
- Built-in command recognition for exporting, checking credits, viewing status, and file uploads.
- All processing handles multiple formats (video, audio, images, text) with clear error handling and progress updates.
